newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile June industrial output up 6.3 pct - group.
newsitem.headline: Chile June industrial output up 6.3 pct - group.

text.p: Chilean industrial production grew 6.3 percent in June compared with the same month last year, bringing the rise in the first six months of the year to 2.7 percent, said trade group Sociedad de Fomento Fabril (Sofofa).
Industrial sales climbed 5.5 percent last month, bringing the increase in the January-June period to 3.5 percent against the same period last year.

Areas with the sharpest growth in production in the first half of the year included glass making, up 42 percent; metallic manufacturing, up 30 percent; and domestic appliance production, which rose 28 percent.
Falls in production were reported in the footwear industry, down 15 percent; food products, down 11 percent; and in oil derivative, output which dropped 10 percent.
